gaps: No official page found that states whether motorcycles need the Nilgiris electronic pass; two independent guides say they do.
Guides disagree on whether the pass is needed all year or only in the controlled season from April to June.
The electronic pass website opened but its form would not load, so its own wording on who needs a pass is not recorded.
No official Karnataka page found for the Bandipur night closure hours; the hours, and the earlier cut-off for two-wheelers, come from news reports of the 2009 order.
Not confirmed whether the summer 2026 closure of the Kalhatti ghat to visiting vehicles is still in force in September 2026.
A green tax at Nilgiris check posts is reported by blogs; no official page states it or what motorcycles pay.
No source found for the usual number of days riders take.
Hairpin bend counts are added as header.hairpin_bends, which is not in the schema example.
One video only; filming date not known. A second candidate could not be checked.
